vector<long long> sequence;
long long compute(long long n, long long l) {
  long long quotient = n / sequence[l];
  n %= sequence[l];
  if (!n) {
    return quotient * l;
  }
  return quotient * l + min(l + compute(sequence[l] - n, l - 1), compute(n, l - 1));
}

int main() {
  ios::sync_with_stdio(false); cin.tie(0);
  long long t = 1, n;

  long long m = 0;

    sequence.push_back(m);
    m = m * 10 + 1;
  }

    cin >> n;
    cout << compute(n, 16);
